rationale: With the Chief Justice in the majority and repeatedly emphasizing a narrow, DMCA-structure-preserving limiting principle, Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion and write a restrained reversal clarifying that willful blindness cannot devolve into “should have known” constructive knowledge untethered to specific infringements. A few separate concurrences are plausible—especially from Thomas/Gorsuch (doctrinal boundaries) and Jackson/Sotomayor (over-termination and due-process concerns)—but the unanimity and shared Global-Tech framing should limit fragmentation.
